detailedAgreementTable.dominantPattern: 26 of 37 disagreements (70%) are V2 asserting a safe-surfacing state (HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED or DISCOVERED_REVIEW_REQUIRED) that the independent reviewer, reading the same raw candidate excerpts, judged does NOT actually correspond to the specific claim (DISCOVERED_ONLY or HONESTLY_UNSUPPORTED). This is precisely the SAFE_SURFACING_REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_CORRESPONDENCE defect this phase exists to fix. The fix implemented (stricter C_OBJECT_RESOURCE bar when action support is absent) measurably improved binary agreement (87.5%->90.5%) but did not close this gap at the detailed level - see 16-remaining-evaluator-risks.json's root-cause diagnosis.
